name: Oficina - Tech Challenge Fase 3
description: Volume de OS, tempo por status, falhas e integrações, latência das APIs, recursos do Kubernetes e uptime (homolog e prod).

pages.name: Negócio
pages.description: Ordens de serviço: volume diário, tempo médio por status e falhas.

widgets.title: Volume diário de ordens de serviço

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'OS criadas' FROM OrdemServicoCriada FACET dateOf(timestamp) AS 'dia', appName SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 50
SELECT count(*) AS 'OS criadas' FROM OrdemServicoCriada FACET appName SINCE today

widgets.title: Tempo médio por status (minutos): Diagnóstico, Execução, Finalização

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(segundosNoStatusAnterior) / 60 AS 'minutos no status' FROM OrdemServicoStatusAlterado WHERE statusAnterior IN ('EM_DIAGNOSTICO', 'EM_EXECUCAO', 'FINALIZADA') FACET statusAnterior SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Tempo médio por status ao longo do tempo (minutos)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(segundosNoStatusAnterior) / 60 FROM OrdemServicoStatusAlterado WHERE statusAnterior IN ('EM_DIAGNOSTICO', 'EM_EXECUCAO', 'FINALIZADA') FACET statusAnterior SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day
SELECT count(*) FROM OrdemServicoStatusAlterado FACET statusAnterior, statusNovo SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM OrdemServicoFalha FACET operacao, erro SINCE 1 day ago TIMESERIES

pages.name: Erros e integrações
pages.description: Falhas nas integrações (SMTP, banco) e erros da aplicação.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM IntegracaoFalha FACET integracao, erro SINCE 1 day ago TIMESERIES
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName LIKE 'tech-challenge-backend%' FACET error.class, appName SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Chamadas ao banco (tempo médio e volume por operação)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'chamadas', average(duration) * 1000 AS 'ms (média)' FROM Span WHERE appName LIKE 'tech-challenge-backend%' AND category = 'datastore' FACET name SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 20
SELECT timestamp, entity.name, level, message FROM Log WHERE entity.name LIKE 'tech-challenge-backend%' AND level IN ('ERROR', 'WARN') SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 50

pages.name: APIs e Kubernetes
pages.description: Latência, vazão e erros das APIs; CPU e memória do cluster; uptime.

widgets.title: Latência das APIs (ms): média e p95

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(duration) * 1000 AS 'média', percentile(duration, 95) * 1000 AS 'p95' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE 'tech-challenge-backend%' FACET appName SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES
SELECT percentile(duration, 95) * 1000 FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE 'tech-challenge-backend%' FACET name SINCE 3 hours ago LIMIT 10
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE 'tech-challenge-backend%' FACET appName SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES
SELECT sum(cpuUsedCores) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'eks-tech-challenge' FACET namespaceName SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES
SELECT sum(memoryWorkingSetBytes) / 1e6 FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'eks-tech-challenge' FACET namespaceName SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

SELECT average(allocatableCpuCoresUtilization) AS 'CPU %', average(allocatableMemoryUtilization) AS 'memória %' FROM K8sNodeSample WHERE clusterName = 'eks-tech-challenge' FACET nodeName SINCE 3 hours ago TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Pods da aplicação e réplicas do HPA

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(currentReplicas) AS 'réplicas', latest(desiredReplicas) AS 'desejadas', latest(maxReplicas) AS 'máximo' FROM K8sHpaSample WHERE clusterName = 'eks-tech-challenge' FACET namespaceName SINCE 30 minutes ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result = 'SUCCESS') AS 'uptime %' FROM SyntheticCheck FACET monitorName SINCE 1 day ago
